name: 小鸮钉台报告
description: 把对话里的结论、数据和待办整理成一页排版好的报告，生成可分享的链接。
description_zh: 把对话里的结论、数据和待办整理成一页排版好的报告，生成可分享的链接。
description_en: Turn the conclusions, numbers and to-dos in a conversation into a polished one-page report with a shareable link.
examples_zh: 把上面的讨论出个报告
把这次周会的结论整理成报告
根据这些数据生成一份报告页
examples_en: Make a report from the discussion above
Turn this meeting's decisions into a report
Create a report page from these numbers
